data.best_angle: Open with one checkable fact: they are running Meta ads for the Evoq sample flat since 13 Oct. Offer the first reply in about a minute with a brochure and a site-visit slot for Evoq. Do not claim they lose enquiries.

Handle printed in the ad text (not used for outreach).

observed_facts: Active Meta ad by Classone Group started 13 Oct 2026 (2 ads use the same creative): sample flat of 4 BHK Class One Evoq, Tulsi Park, Sopan Luxuria Road, Raiya Hills, Rajkot; phone printed in the ad. Re-opened by the chat session in the Meta Ad Library on 2026-10-27 (the daily researcher got HTTP 403): the CTA button text was not read on the page.

Class One Infra is a partnership firm, incorporated 14 Aug 2023, with 8 named partners including Bhavin Udaykumar Nathwani. Its project Class One Evoq (RERA PR/GJ/RAJKOT/RAJKOT/Rajkot Municipal Corporation/RAA15532/180725/311229) was approved 18 Jul 2025, with 56 units and completion due 31 Dec 2029. (2025-07-18 (approval), https://www.aurumproptech.in/pulse/rera/gujarat/rajkot/class-one-evoq/26534)

The RERA data shows construction progress of 14.2% (Jan 2026) and 22.05% (Apr 2026). The page also shows 0 of 56 units booked, but this is a RERA self-declaration and likely stale, so it is not evidence of unsold stock. (2026-04, https://www.aurumproptech.in/pulse/rera/gujarat/rajkot/class-one-evoq/26534)

Houssed lists Class One Evoq as a New Launch, 4 BHK, carpet about 1,140-1,150 sq ft, Rs 80-85 lakh, 56 units, 1 tower of 15 floors, with a WhatsApp 'Connect Now' link to +91 81691 14718. (None, https://houssed.com/rajkot/class-one-infra/class-one-evoq-161259)
hypotheses: The finder's claim of two active Meta ads started 2026-10-13 with a WhatsApp CTA is plausible but UNVERIFIED by me (the Ad Library returned 403). If true, they pay for WhatsApp-click leads and have a live inbound channel to automate.

A sales team that runs ad-driven WhatsApp enquiries for a 56-unit, Rs 80-85 lakh project probably misses some evening and night enquiries. This is inference only, with no evidence of actual response times.
The firm likely sells through a small in-house team and/or channel brokers. Nothing was found about its sales setup or whether it already uses a WhatsApp tool or a CRM.
Gross inventory is roughly 56 x Rs 80-85 lakh, about Rs 45-48 crore, so the firm can afford a small automation fee. This is arithmetic from the listed price and unit count.
data.case_for: Real developer with a live project and live paid ads that open WhatsApp (verified in the Ad Library by the chat session). The business exists and is verified through a RERA record (via a mirror) plus an independent listing portal. It is a real, young, single-project Rajkot developer with a high-ticket product (Rs 80-85 lakh x 56 units) and eight named partners. It is in the target geography and size band, with no site or CRM vendor visible. If the finder's WhatsApp-CTA ads are real, it matches the offer well.
data.case_against: Slow replies are not shown anywhere: ads that bring enquiries are normal for a developer. The ad CTA could not be read; the project is 56 units (smaller buyer). The ads say Classone Group, the RERA promoter is Class One Infra.
data.next_step: Owner review, then add to the campaign. Grade B was raised from C by the chat session after it opened the ads itself (the researcher could not: HTTP 403).

hypotheses: The finder's two Meta ads (14 and 16 Oct 2026) with WhatsApp CTA could not be verified by me; if real, the team already pays for WhatsApp-click enquiries and handles them manually. This is the finder's claim, not my observation.
With roughly 419 unsold units and 14 months to the Dec 2027 completion date, plus likely festival-season ad spend, speed-to-first-reply probably matters commercially.
Evening and night enquiries probably wait for a human, because the firm has no visible sales team or website. This is inference.
'Shreem Group' is likely a loose brand for sister partnership firms around the Vekariya/Patel/Panchal partners; no legal entity named Shreem Group was found.

Shreem Design's director Yogesh Panchal is probably the same person as developer partner Yogeshkumar Pravinchandra Panchal, which makes info@shreemdesign.com a warm route to the partners. Unconfirmed.
data.case_for: Real developer with a live project and live paid ads that open WhatsApp (verified in the Ad Library by the chat session). Real, RERA-registered, owner-run developer. About Rs 108 cr live project with roughly 419 unsold units, a sister project of Rs 144 cr, and partners who can pay for a small automation. No website and portal-led marketing suggest no existing CRM or bot. A phone/WhatsApp route exists. If the Meta WhatsApp ads are real, it is a strong fit and should move to B (possibly A with a named decision-maker).
data.case_against: Pain (slow replies) is inferred, not seen: a WhatsApp CTA is standard. Informal brand Shreem over a partnership firm; contacts are only the ad numbers and a free-mail address; no own website found.
data.next_step: Owner review, then add to the campaign. Grade B was raised from C by the chat session after it opened the ads itself (the researcher could not: HTTP 403).
